headline: Arsenal host Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League at 3:00 PM, while England levelled the T20I series in Australia overnight.
today: 9:00 AM: Gukesh v Sindarov, World Chess Championship Game 1 (start time TBC), YouTube
3:00 PM: Arsenal v Borussia Dortmund, Champions League, Paramount+

recaps.text: England chased Australia's 184-8 on the Gold Coast, reaching 188-2 in 13.1 overs to level the T20I series after Australia won the opener by three wickets.

lookAhead: Friday's third T20I (3:15 AM) and the Players Championship Finals start, Saturday brings England v New Zealand (11:40 AM), and Sunday 29 November has Arsenal v Manchester City (11:30 AM) and the Jets at the Dolphins (1:00 PM).
